findings.description: The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects uploaded without explicit SSE headers, including the managed seed object, are not guaranteed to use a customer-managed encryption key or an explicitly configured encryption control.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Its private ACL does not encrypt stored ledger exports; uploaded objects are not assured of encryption by this Terraform configuration.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning and access logging do not protect the confidentiality of model artifacts at rest.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Runbook content uploaded without an explicit encryption request is not assured of encryption by this configuration.
